column1: // Constructions of the rewrite layer (docs/rule-language.md, 구문 표): the Korean of a word picked
// from the words around it, after the word stage has chosen every candidate.
// A family is declared once by "//= FAMILY <TAB> after NAME <TAB> what it is for" and runs right
// after the text pass or family NAME. Its rows are ID <TAB> SPEC <TAB> CONDITION <TAB> ACTIONS
// <TAB> NOTE, ID being cx:FAMILY:PRIO. On each word from the left, the first row of the family by
// PRIO whose condition holds applies its actions.

column3: The に read 에 after a noun the sense table reads as an adjectival noun is its adverb ending 하게.

column3: The と after a number or a bracketed noun is (와)과 before a word of company or a noun partner, and after a number (이)라고 before a verb of saying, thinking or naming. A bracketed word span an earlier stage read is an utterance, so its と quotes.

The と after a noun is (와)과 before a word of company or comparison, and (이)라고 before a verb of naming or supposing.
&&8 S+0== "と" F+0== "selected" F-1== "selected" F+1== "selected" F-1!= "conjugating" P-1== "1" ||3 L+0== "(으)로" L+0== "(이)라고" L+0== "라고" B+1== @word.comitative
&&8 S+0== "と" F+0== "selected" F-1== "selected" F+1== "selected" F-1!= "conjugating" P-1== "1" L+0== "(와)과" ||2 B+1== @verb.naming B+1== @word.supposing
A と that opens a line or follows a sentence end on it quotes what was said before it: (이)라고. Not before an ellipsis or another と, nor before なる or する (となると), nor before a word of company (と一緒に).
